answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 41900 Country: India Title: Qasr Salah Question: Please let us know if qasr is applicable to me at my father-in-law place (Mysore) if I stay less than 15 days? For your information I also own one site in my name in this place. I was told qasr is not applicable in my work place and home town and rest all the places qasr is applicable. For your information I also own one site in my name in this place. Please clarify. Answer ID: 41900 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1584/1005/L=1433) If the husband keeps his wife at the house of his father-in-law permanently then qasr is not wajib on him. If he has not kept his wife there permanently then offering full salah there shall not be correct provided he does not intend to stay there for fifteen days and the distance is of 77.25 kms. In the same way the ruling of offering complete salah at work place is in the case when he has his property there and intends to stay there permanently. But if these things are not found then the ruling of offering complete salah shall not be applicable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
